author: Kushal
problem: String T is string S with one lowercase letter inserted somewhere. Read S and T and print the 1-based position in T of an inserted letter (any valid position if there are several).
bug_description: When S matches the start of T completely (the letter was added at the end), it prints 1 instead of len(T).

comments.accurate: Prints the position in T of the inserted letter, found at the first mismatch with S
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the first position where S and T differ, defaulting to 1 when no difference is found
comments.wrong_location: Fallback output verified; check the loop index against T's length when S is shorter
